notes.title: Garm Ruins ver1.0.7 update contents
notes.notes:
Hello. We have made ver1.0.7 update of Garm Ruins.

 Fixed a bug where rock salt bullets were too painful in alogene fights.
 Increased the bounty for rematch bosses.
 Implemented a counter to the gekkou zan when fully charged.
 Fixed some skill text flaws.
 Made the teacher's long story even longer.
 Fixed a bug when moving to an area.


Thank you for your continued support of Garm Ruins.

notes.title: Garm Ruins ver1.0.6 update contents
notes.notes:
Hello. We have made ver1.0.5 update of Garm Ruins.


 "Just Parry" has been implemented.
If you use a skill at close range when an enemy is glowing, "Just Parry" will be activated.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44873519/d570f63387c410f6129555f71e4029bbddbb717f.png
[previewyoutube=R27Zi1IMLZY;full][/previewyoutube]
We've beefed up the grout knight's shield. Use it as a training ground for Just Parry.
Updated archive content.
The map of the deep area has been implemented.
(Released by touching the map terminal in the deep area or by talking to the professor after clearing the area.)
The ejection damage of the variant bit was revised downward.
It was too strong.



Thank you for your continued support of Garm Ruins.

notes.title: GarmRuins ver1.0.1 Update completion notice
notes.notes:
The update was originally scheduled for June 1st, but was brought forward.
I did it.

 Fixed an issue where save data could not be carried over when updating. 

Change the key/mouse operation on the menu screen to "SPACE: Confirm Esc: Cancel".
The screen no longer moves every time you click on the menu screen.

Change the full screen mode setting from Esc to F11.

Modify the kick climb to have lateral inertia.
Increase the grace period for cliff jumping.

Fixed an error in the map tip.

Update some graphics.

Adjust the balance of the final boss battle.
Fixed some confusing gimmicks.

Fixed so that Q-warp can be performed even when crouching.
That way you can get out of the wall.

Improves the usability of bombs.

notes.title: [Important] Transfer of saved data in the next update
notes.notes:
Save data from ver1.0.0 cannot be transferred to ver1.0.1 or later. 

This is due to an elementary mistake.
Saved data after ver1.0.1 will be able to be transferred after subsequent updates.

The next update is scheduled for June or later.
Prior notification will be given before the update.

Please understand.

notes.title: Garm Ruins Scheduled for release on May 1!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience!
GarmRuins will be released on May 1, 2024!
Of course you can play for free!
Best regards, and thank you very much for your interest!
